item.title: Azerbaijan Land Transport Agency rolls out tender for insurance service purchase
item.description: The Azerbaijan Land Transport Agency has launched a tender for the procurement of voluntary medical insurance services. Interested companies must submit their proposals by February 25, 2026, with a participation fee required.

item.title: Uzbekistan records 9% growth in EV market in January 2026
item.description: Uzbekistan’s electric vehicle market surged in January 2026, led by strong demand in Tashkent and rapid growth across several regions.

item.title: Iran’s saffron industry shows export uptick in early 2026
item.description: Iran's saffron exports saw a modest increase in the first 10 months of the current Iranian year compared to the same period last year. The country exported a higher amount of saffron during this period. This growth reflects a positive trend in the industry.

item.title: Azerbaijan's National Depository Center set to procure audit service via tender
